create_rmsnorm: create an RMSNorm layer with hidden_size, epsilon, and optional residual fusion support
create_layernorm: create a LayerNorm layer with hidden_size, epsilon, elementwise_affine, and bias options
create_gemma_rmsnorm: create a GemmaRMSNorm layer that precomputes weight+1 for fused add-rmsnorm kernels
create_gemma3_rmsnorm: create a Gemma3RMSNorm layer using scaled RMS normalization without bias
create_gemma4_rmsnorm: create a Gemma4RMSNorm layer with configurable scale_shift and with_scale options
